checks.title: Custom CPU and GPU readback
steps: Save the current profile, CPU level, GPU level, and fan setting.
Select Custom with Automatic fans.
Apply CPU Boost and GPU Low once.
Confirm OpenBlade reports both requested levels after its independent reads.
checks.expected: Each cluster is read back independently and the saved state returns without a preset reset.
checks.restore: Restore the saved profile, CPU level, GPU level, and fan setting, then confirm readback.

checks.title: Balanced fan curve behavior
steps: Save the current profile and fan settings.
Check OpenBlade live readings for CPU temperature and either GPU temperature or inactive GPU state.
If a required temperature is unavailable, record unavailable or the maximum speed fallback and stop.
Select Balanced and the fan curve editor without creating extra system load.
At the current temperatures, set one CPU point and one GPU point to different safe values.
Compare stored targets with measured RPM for both fans.
checks.expected: Available temperatures drive separate curve targets; missing data reports unavailable or uses the safe maximum. RPM stays separate.
checks.restore: Restore the saved profile, fan mode, and curve points, then confirm the reported state.

checks.title: Custom Automatic fan handoff
steps: Save a confirmed Balanced or Silent fixed fan setting.
Select Custom and wait for the state to settle.
Confirm OpenBlade reports Custom with Automatic fans.
Return to the saved preset and confirm the saved fan intent with target readback.
checks.expected: The settled Custom state is Automatic and the saved manual intent returns with its admitted preset.
checks.restore: Return to the saved preset and fixed fan setting, then confirm target readback.

checks.title: Silent fixed fan range
steps: Save the current profile and fan settings.
Select Silent and set one supported fixed value such as 4200 RPM.
Confirm both stored targets report the requested value.
Observe both measured RPM values without treating them as stored target readback.
checks.expected: Silent accepts its recovered range, reports both targets, and restores saved state.
checks.restore: Restore the saved profile and fan settings, then confirm the reported state.

checks.title: Maximum Fans round trip
steps: Save the current Custom levels and fan setting.
Select Custom with Automatic fans.
Try to enable Maximum Fans once. If OpenBlade blocks it, record unavailable and stop without changing other controls.
If enabled, confirm OpenBlade reads it as enabled.
Disable Maximum Fans once and confirm OpenBlade reads it as disabled.
checks.expected: The control either reports a guarded block or reads back enabled and disabled states before restoration.
checks.restore: Disable Maximum Fans if needed and restore the saved Custom levels and fan setting.

checks.title: Per key colors and sequence playback
steps: Save the current built in lighting effect and brightness.
Apply a small per key color layout that includes Enter, an arrow key, and one letter.
Confirm the colors appear on the intended physical keys for this keyboard region.
Play a short non looping sequence and confirm its final frame remains visible.
checks.expected: Regional key projection is correct, the final sequence frame is held, and the saved built in baseline is restored.
checks.restore: End the imported effect and restore the saved built in effect and brightness.

checks.title: Host rendered Breathing and Wave
steps: Save the current built in lighting effect and brightness.
Apply dual color Breathing and observe one complete pulse.
Apply leftward Wave and observe one complete pass.
Confirm both effects cover the expected Blade 18 keyboard.
checks.expected: Both host patterns animate over the Blade 18 layout and retire to the saved baseline.
checks.restore: End the animated effect and restore the saved built in effect and brightness.

checks.title: Representative spatial lighting
steps: Save the current built in lighting effect and brightness.
Apply Reactive and press one mapped letter key once.
Apply Ripple and press the same key once.
Apply outward Tidal and observe one full wave period.
Confirm each effect originates from or projects across the expected physical positions.
checks.expected: One representative input pulse and one projected wave follow the recovered regional geometry, then restore the saved baseline.
checks.restore: End the spatial effect and restore the saved built in effect and brightness.

checks.title: Fn performance and refresh actions
steps: Save the current performance profile and display refresh rate.
Press Fn plus P once and confirm exactly one profile advance.
Press Fn plus R once and confirm exactly one supported refresh rate advance.
Confirm neither action is duplicated by firmware or another controller.
checks.expected: The source backed Fn report reaches the service and display paths once per press and both settings are restored.
checks.restore: Restore the saved performance profile and display refresh rate.

checks.title: Representative Fn Windows actions
steps: Save touchpad state and system volume, then open a safe navigation test window.
Press Fn plus T once and confirm one touchpad toggle.
Press Fn plus F2 once and confirm one volume step.
Press Fn plus Left once and confirm one Home action in the test window.
Confirm no action is duplicated.
checks.expected: Three materially different host action paths execute once per press without affecting unrelated keyboards.
checks.restore: Restore saved touchpad state and system volume, then close the test window.

checks.title: Host Gaming Mode policy
steps: Save the current Gaming Mode state and key policy.
Enable blocking for the Windows key and Alt plus Tab.
Confirm both shortcuts are blocked while OpenBlade is running.
Disable Gaming Mode and confirm both shortcuts work again.
checks.expected: The host policy blocks only while enabled and releases both shortcuts when disabled.
checks.restore: Restore the saved Gaming Mode state and key policy and confirm normal shortcuts work.

checks.title: Startup animation state readback
steps: If OpenBlade does not expose the control after state readback, record unavailable and stop.
Save the reported startup animation state.
Toggle the control once.
Confirm OpenBlade independently reads the new state.
Restore the saved state and confirm it by readback.
checks.expected: When the control is admitted, both the changed and restored states are independently read back without a power cycle.
checks.restore: Restore the saved startup animation state and confirm it by readback.

checks.title: Temporary full charge behavior
steps: If OpenBlade does not expose the control after state readback, record unavailable and stop.
Save the charge limit, override state, battery percentage, and power source.
Unless protection is active, power is connected, and battery is at or above the limit but below 100 percent, mark skipped.
Enable temporary full charge once without changing the charge policy.
Record OpenBlade override readback and the current Windows charging status.
Disable the override and confirm the saved charge policy is unchanged.
checks.expected: The override and restoration are read back. Record charging status without treating no change as proof of no support.
checks.restore: Disable the override if needed and restore the saved charge limit and override state, then confirm both.

checks.title: Per device Fn primary ABI
steps: Use the reviewed PID02A0 suppression and output contract as the baseline.
Review exact-model Fn-primary and keyboard-mode semantics separately from default Fn shortcuts.
Identify the missing function-row admission and restoration contract without loading vendor components or running input tests.
checks.expected: SnapTap ABI review does not admit function-row inversion; exact-model Fn-primary semantics and guarded restoration remain separate research.

checks.title: Firmware Gaming Mode boundary
steps: Review exact Product 672 feature gates and inherited command definitions.
Look for a model specific getter, setter, and readback contract.
Keep the implemented host key policy separately labeled unless complete firmware evidence is found.
checks.expected: The host policy remains distinct from any future firmware Gaming Mode admission and readback claim.

checks.title: Legacy THX endpoint binding
steps: Use the reviewed exact RZ09-0484 legacy COM spatial-control contract as the baseline.
Inspect original endpoint FX bindings and signed component ancestry from owner-provided evidence.
Resolve fresh installation and model-specific validation gaps without installing components or changing audio settings.
checks.expected: Existing installed-component spatial control stays experimental; fresh provisioning remains blocked until endpoint binding and the installation contract are reviewed.

checks.title: SnapTap model validation gaps
steps: Use the reviewed PID02A0 filter and shared RzCommon API contract as the baseline.
Review owner-provided installed package, service, keyboard and control topology evidence without a driver build-hash allowlist.
Identify remaining model-specific input, setup and recovery validation without installing drivers or running input tests.
checks.expected: The Razer backend is source-backed experimental; package and API admission remain mandatory, and physical validation is separate.

checks.title: HyperBoost command admission
steps: Search pinned exact model source for a complete HyperBoost feature gate and typed command contract.
Require exact getter, setter, supported states, prerequisites, and restoration semantics.
Keep HyperBoost observed only if any contract element is missing.
checks.expected: No Blade 18 HyperBoost write is admitted from a shared path or another model command.

checks.title: Custom and Performance fixed fans
steps: Search exact Product 672 source for active manual ranges and feature gates in Custom and Performance.
Distinguish an unused declared range from an enabled command path.
Retain Automatic entry for Custom and no Performance fixed range unless complete evidence is recovered.
checks.expected: Balanced and Silent admission does not expand into Custom or Performance without exact activation and readback evidence.

checks.title: Silent fan curves
steps: Review exact model source for Silent curve activation, range, and temperature semantics.
Check whether the current Balanced curve contract can be shared without changing preset rules.
Keep curves Balanced only if any Silent contract element is missing.
checks.expected: Silent fixed targets do not imply Silent variable curve support.

checks.title: CPU temperature fallback
steps: Review the requested sensor telemetry report for both known TZRZ counters and measured values.
If neither counter works, identify a standalone read only CPU package source independent of Synapse components.
Do not relabel thermal zones, utilization, or limits as CPU package temperature.
checks.expected: Variable fan curves use a measured CPU source or retain the documented fixed maximum fallback.

covered.summary: Existing bundles establish RZ09-0484, USB 1532:02A0, BIOS provenance, and report geometry.
Synapse recordings cover Silent and Custom plus CPU Boost, CPU Medium, GPU High, and GPU Low requests.
Synapse recordings cover Balanced Automatic, fixed 3000 RPM, stored 3800 RPM, and fan one RPM queries.
Synapse recordings cover charge limit 80 to 50 percent and restoration to 80 percent.
Synapse recordings cover brightness 100 to 25 percent and restoration to 100 percent.
Synapse recordings provide Fire samples and one clockwise Wheel cycle over the six row transport.
Synapse recordings cover logo Static, Off, and restored Static with the Blade 18 selector.
Product 672 source recovers nine regional maps, per key projection, sequences, and spatial effects.
